name: preserves_mono_of_preservesLimit
statement: C} (f : X ⟶ Y) [PreservesLimit (cospan f f) F] [Mono f] : Mono (F.map f)

name: reflects_mono_of_reflectsLimit
statement: C} (f : X ⟶ Y) [ReflectsLimit (cospan f f) F] [Mono (F.map f)] : Mono f

name: preserves_epi_of_preservesColimit
statement: C} (f : X ⟶ Y) [PreservesColimit (span f f) F] [Epi f] : Epi (F.map f)

name: reflects_epi_of_reflectsColimit
statement: C} (f : X ⟶ Y) [ReflectsColimit (span f f) F] [Epi (F.map f)] : Epi f
